source: Open-Meteo historical weather API, daily temperature_2m_max, temperature_2m_min and precipitation_sum, 2015-01-01 to 2024-12-31, Asia/Kolkata.
delta_note: Temperature deltas of +1.2°C (SSP2-4.5) and +1.9°C (SSP5-8.5) are a uniform screen for 2041–2060 against the 2015–2024 normals. They sit in the IPCC AR6 South Asia mid-century range above the recent climate. Rainfall is left unchanged because the regional rainfall signal is uncertain. This is not a WorldClim grid.
